name: Run native Nix hash verification
command:
set -e
if [ -e /nix ]; then echo 'Refusing to replace an existing Nix installation'; exit 1; fi
sudo -n install -d -o "$(id -u)" -g "$(id -g)" /nix
cp -a /tmp/t3code-nix-sync/.nix-portable/nix/. /nix/
/nix/store/j823gnvpxh1fjibycmldrspkk3pgivwp-nix-2.20.6/bin/nix --extra-experimental-features 'nix-command flakes' --option build-users-group '' --option sandbox false build .#unwrapped.pnpmDeps .#server.pnpmDeps --no-link --keep-going
